briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 edges Claude 4 in reasoning benchmarks as compute arms race accelerates

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs intensify competition with rapid releases in multimodal and agentic systems. Regulatory scrutiny grows while multimodal capabilities redefine benchmarks across the board.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced tool use; Anthropic launches Claude 4 Opus. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while DeepSeek unveils cost-leading variants.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, securing new automotive and IoT pilots.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra ramps production; Microsoft and Google expand Texas and Arizona data centers. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume manufacturing.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the gap to closed frontier systems before 2027?
